target_definition: Mean of T+2 through T+6 open returns relative to T+1 open, industry and log-float-market-cap neutralized and cross-sectionally ranked

rejected_target.name: target_rank
rejected_target.reason: The path target beat the endpoint target in annual return and Sharpe in all three development years, improved full-period drawdown by 2.27 percentage points, and led by 4.98 percentage points under the preregistered 20bp fixed-path stress.

selection_basis: The eight engineered features were fixed for both candidates. The path target passed every preregistered development-period gate before the physically separate holdout was scored.
unmet_gates: Development-period absolute return is slightly negative.
At 20bp fixed-path cost, holdout GBRT annual return does not exceed Elastic Net.
Holdout annual return does not exceed the CSI 300 benchmark.
Deflated Sharpe Ratio and complete multiple-testing inventory are not evaluated.
Announcement-quality financial PIT data and forward paper trading are not complete.
